item.title: Leqembi FDA Delay
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA has delayed its decision on Biogen and Eisai's subcutaneous formulation of Leqembi (lecanemab) for Alzheimer's disease by three months. The delay may impact the rollout of the more convenient dosing option. Leqembi is an anti-amyloid beta antibody already approved intravenously.
  • MoAs: Lecanemab is a humanized monoclonal antibody that targets soluble amyloid beta protofibrils, reducing amyloid plaques in the brain.
  • Sources: Endpoints News, BioSpace

item.title: J&J Depression Project
item.description:
• Summary: Johnson & Johnson launches the 'Generation Fine' depression project, a marketing and awareness initiative aimed at destigmatizing depression and encouraging earlier intervention. The campaign leverages digital tools and partnerships to reach younger adults and promote the company's portfolio of depression treatments.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma
